jobs.description:
As a Senior Director, Senior Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be a part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud.

You will work alongside our talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while driving towards strong technology solutions.

At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence, and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring internal talent and actively recruiting to keep building our community.

Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other material to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization.

In this role, you will be the technical lead for the Customer Management engineering organization, setting and delivering the technical agenda for the foundational platforms and horizontal thread teams (SRE, Sustained Engineering, Data, and Operations). You will manage the entire credit card customer lifecycle—from offer management to retention—to ensure a seamless and delightful experience. You will make credit decisioning & offers real time and intelligent, spanning dynamic credit offers, line, balance transfer, product upgrades, retention offers leveraging novel data sources and predictive models, as well as quantitative in-market testing and experimentation. You will drive an agenda to ship exponentially more products, experiences, and offers by arming cross-functional partners with GenAI tools, datasets, experimentation frameworks, and configurable/extensible systems that allow for self-service product delivery. All with one overarching goal: put more Capital One cards in more wallets.

You will lead 100+ engineers across multiple directors, grow high-potential senior leaders, and even found a novel SRE function that raises operational excellence across the entire Customer Management domain. This is not a pure architecture role and you will work elbow-to-elbow with project teams coding, delivering, optimizing and operating the systems you design. The ideal candidate will excel at both surveying broad business domains, crafting a technical strategy to support the many possible futures of the business, and diving deep into the details and personally delivering the highest-leverage projects from that roadmap.

If you are ready to provide thought leadership and build engineering excellence across Capital One's engineering teams, come join us in our mission to change banking for good.

Articulate and evangelize a bold technical vision for your domain
Decompose complex problems into practical and operational solutions
Ensure the quality of technical design and implementation
Serve as an authoritative expert on non-functional system characteristics, such as performance, scalability and operability
Continue learning and injecting advanced technical knowledge into our community
Handle several projects simultaneously, balancing your time to maximize impact
Act as a role model and mentor within the tech community, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know-how of our engineering and product community
Partner with product management to set an ambitious roadmap for expanding Capital One’s reach.
Hands-on full-stack coding (frontend, backend, data processing, automation)
Lead the multi-year strategy to decommission legacy systems and converge the destination stack, reducing maintenance overhead and eliminating duplicative customer experiences across channels.
Stand up and scale a hybrid SRE + Engineering Productivity function supporting the entire Acquisitions engineering org, achieving strong statistical process control and operational maturity.
Design solutions that enable non-technical contributors to design, test, and deliver marketing experiments, UI treatments, and credit offers.

Bachelor’s Degree
At least 9 years of experience in Software engineering and solution architecture
At least 9 years of experience in Enterprise architecture and design patterns
At least 9 years of experience with Javascript, TypeScript and SPA frameworks

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field
10+ years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems architecture, or platform engineering
5+ years of experience leading large-scale engineering organizations (50+ engineers across multiple management layers)
Deep experience with API design, microservices architecture, and platform evolution in high-availability, high-throughput environments
Experience founding or leading SRE / production excellence functions, including SLO management, incident response, and reliability engineering
Demonstrated ability to partner with product management and business stakeholders to co-own product strategy — not just take tickets

Job Description

Drive strategy, build relationships, and solidify Oracle’s position as the cloud leader for global business.

About The Role

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced engineering executive to lead the next evolution of its Storage organization. This is a unique opportunity to lead one of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's most strategically important engineering organizations during a period of rapid transformation.

This leader will oversee engineering teams responsible for maintaining production services, completing several large multi-year strategic initiatives, and incubating the next generation of storage technologies. You'll help define how cloud storage evolves to support AI, agentic computing, and the next generation of enterprise applications while leading teams responsible for services that operate at global scale.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in distributed systems with a proven ability to build high-performing engineering organizations, execute large-scale transformations, and inspire teams to solve some of cloud computing's most complex infrastructure challenges.

About The Business

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of cloud infrastructure for enterprises around the world. We combine the agility of a startup with the scale, security, and customer focus of one of the world's largest technology companies.

Storage is a foundational service within OCI and is undergoing significant transformation. As AI, agentic computing, and next-generation cloud workloads reshape how data is stored, accessed, and managed, Oracle is investing heavily in reimagining the storage platform for the future. This is an opportunity to lead engineering at the center of that transformation and influence technology that supports both Oracle's largest enterprise customers and the broader OCI ecosystem.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

Lead a large, geographically distributed engineering organization responsible for OCI Storage innovation.
Ensuring the reliability and continuous improvement of existing production systems.
Delivering several large-scale, multi-year strategic infrastructure initiatives.
Building new product incubations that will shape the future of OCI Storage.

Drive the evolution of next-generation storage platforms designed to scale across Oracle's global cloud infrastructure.
Lead architectural decisions involving distributed systems, large-scale data movement, caching strategies, latency optimization, scalability, cost efficiency, and durability versus availability tradeoffs.
Create organizational capacity that enables engineering teams to continue innovating while maintaining operational excellence.
Partner closely with engineering leaders across OCI to define long-term technical strategy and execution.
Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering leaders and distributed teams while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence.

What You’ll Bring

Proven success leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale distributed systems with a focus lower in the technology stack.
Experience managing organizations of 50+ engineers, with demonstrated success building and developing engineering leaders.
Experience leading large-scale system modernization or architectural refactoring initiatives.
Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence.
Experience solving complex infrastructure challenges involving large-scale data movement, recovery, throttling, caching, and system reliability.
Demonstrated ability to balance execution of existing production workloads while investing in future platform innovation.
Experience leading engineering organizations within major cloud providers such as OCI, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

Year-one success criteria

Deliver key milestones across multiple strategic infrastructure initiatives while maintaining operational excellence.
Improve organizational scalability, engineering efficiency, and technical execution.
Establish a clear vision for the next generation of OCI Storage architecture and build momentum behind future product incubation efforts.

Drive execution of TwoTwenty's 1–3 year technical strategy across visual AI assistants, gen-AI creation tools, and visual editing experiences

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the Strands team, own the technical strategy, scale the engineering organization, and grow the open source community. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of AI/ML innovation, developer tools, and open source — you'll define how AWS enables developers worldwide to build autonomous AI agents.

Lead the vision and execution for the Strands Agents SDK
Build and scale a world-class engineering team delivering the core agentic loop, multi-agent orchestration, and observability
Drive open source community growth, partner engagement, and ecosystem expansion
Represent Strands to customers, partners, and developers

Key job responsibilities

Own the roadmap, delivery, and operations for the Strands Agents SDK spanning the agentic loop, tool ecosystem, multi-agent orchestration, observability, and deployment patterns.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing engineering organization, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and speed.
Drive open source community strategy including contributor experience, governance, ecosystem expansion (MCP servers, model providers, integrations).
Partner with senior leaders across AWS (Kiro, Amazon Quick, Bedrock, SageMaker) and external partners (Anthropic, Meta) to align roadmaps and co-develop capabilities.
Set and raise the technical bar — establish AI-assisted development workflows, drive architectural decisions, and ensure the framework remains model-driven and developer-friendly.
Drive executive alignment through VP-level reviews, PR/FAQs, and strategic narratives positioning Strands within AWS's broader AI strategy.
Champion production readiness — own deployment toolkits, reference architectures, and observability patterns that take agents from prototype to production.
Represent Strands externally at conferences, in blog posts, and through direct customer engagement.

A day in the life

You'll split your time between strategic leadership and hands-on technical engagement. Mornings might include reviewing community PRs and contributor roadmaps, followed by architecture deep-dives with your engineering leads on multi-agent orchestration. Afternoons could involve partnering with Amazon Q Developer or Bedrock teams on integration work, presenting roadmap updates to VP-level stakeholders, or engaging directly with customers adopting Strands for production workloads. You operate as the single-threaded owner for Strands across open source, product, and engineering.

About The Team

The Strands team builds the open source toolkit for production AI agents at AWS. We believe that as LLMs become increasingly capable at reasoning and tool use, agent development should become simpler — not more complex. Our model-driven approach lets the model do the planning while we provide the infrastructure to make it reliable, observable, and scalable. We work in the open, ship fast, and measure success by the community of developers building real-world agents with Strands. We are part of AWS Velocity Labs.

Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
